inputs.xtext_rule_text:
AnnotatingElement returns SysML::AnnotatingElement :
	  Comment 
	| Documentation
	| TextualRepresentation
	| MetadataUsage
;

decision: SysML 8.2.2.4.1 prints MetadataFeature as the fourth alternative, KerML's wording; the SysML Xtext writes MetadataUsage. That disagreement is already adjudicated and recorded as deviation AnnotatingElement (follow_xtext): SysML reads MetadataUsage, which its abstract syntax makes a MetadataFeature, so the printed alternative is satisfied rather than contradicted. The first three alternatives match the clause and the Xtext exactly.

evidence.note: follow_xtext: the fourth alternative is MetadataUsage in SysML

notes: This is one of the two SysML boundary deviations (ADR-0015); it keeps KerML's MetadataBody and kernel out of the SysML grammar.
